newsitem.title: CHINA: China sentences U.S. businessman to 10 years.
newsitem.headline: China sentences U.S. businessman to 10 years.

text.p: A Shanghai court sentenced U.S. businessman William Ping Chen on Monday to 10 years in jail for smuggling, fined him 500,000 ($60,000) and ordered him to be deported, the official Xinhua news agency said.
Chen had pleaded guilty to charges of smuggling banned goods, including 238 tonnes of garbage and a small amount of waste medical items from July to December 1995, Xinhua said.
The Shanghai Number One People's Intermediate Court sentenced Chen to 10 years in jail and ordered his expulsion. It was not clear whether Chen was to be deported immediately.
Chen, 56, who was arrested last year, was sentenced following an open hearing on December 2 last year, Xinhua said.
